svg.title: Index Translator browser components, output
svg.desc: The page's main module renders a translation as Markdown only when the source looks like it. The parser is pure, and the DOM builder never parses a string as HTML. A SubRip text is shown as a table of cues by its own builder. After a finished translation the link check disables or flags links the source did not have, and the paragraph module counts the paragraphs of both sides. output: public/app.ts → public/markdown-dom.ts → public/links.ts → public/paragraphs.ts. subtitles: public/app.ts → public/markdown-dom.ts → public/subtitle-dom.ts → public/subtitles.ts.
